name: Yuri
source:
"No matter how much you humiliate me, my heart belongs to the lord alone!"

She has a soothing voice and refined vocabulary. She puts the people around her at ease. She lives in silent prayer, and is a prim and proper nun.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4118730/The_Sinful_Nuns_Undelivered_Prayers/]Steam[/url]]
